findings.problem: Active transitive imperative with an unmarked object. This locale forms bare noun compounds without का/की elsewhere in the same file (एजेंट पेज, एजेंट हब), so 'एजेंट सूची से हटाएँ' also parses as 'remove [the agent-list] from ...'. The dialog title marks the object ('इस एजेंट को सूची से हटाएँ?'), and shipped hi pairs सूची से हटाना with a को-marked object (ui.agentMessages.settings.allowlist.cue_remove: 'किसी को सूची से हटाने पर ...'). The passive siblings (details.delisting, details.failure.delist) are correct as written: a passive promotes the object to subject and must drop को, so they are not part of this finding.
findings.safety_note: Meaning in context is recoverable and the control is owner-only, so this is not a blocker; the suggested wording keeps details.delist_confirm (हटाएँ) contained in the accessible name.

findings.problem: The possessive का reads either as 'the like on the agent' or as 'the agent's own like', while the pair it belongs to uses different case roles: tooltip_unliked is 'एजेंट को लाइक करें' (को) and the favourite pair is 'एजेंट को पसंदीदा से हटाएँ' (को ... से). English 'Unlike agent' is a verb on the agent, not a possession.
findings.suggested: लाइक हटाएँ (or एजेंट से लाइक हटाएँ if the object must be named)

findings.current: पसंदीदा में बदलाव नहीं हो सका
findings.problem: Adds a 'change' the English does not say ('The favourite did not go through') and breaks parallelism with the sibling in the same alert slot, failure.like 'लाइक नहीं हो सका'. The two adjacent controls report through one slot, so the reader meets two different constructions for one failure shape.
findings.suggested: पसंदीदा नहीं बनाया जा सका (or पसंदीदा नहीं हो सका, mirroring the like line)
